entries.jp: {FFEE}闇を振り払え！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Drive away the darkness!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0020}アンタは闇なんかじゃない！{n}この世界を救う光よ！{p}{v:0021}信じてるから、アンタも自分を信じるのよ！{n}いっけーー！
entries.en: {v:0020}You're not darkness! You're the light that'll save{n}this world!{p}{v:0021}I believe in you, so you believe in yourself too! Gooo!

entries.jp: {v:004B}闇が身体に満ちる‥‥{n}力がわいてくるわ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:004B}Darkness fills my body... I feel power welling up...

entries.jp: {v:004C}闇が身体に満ちる‥‥{n}力がわいてくるぞ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:004C}Darkness fills my body... I feel power welling up...

entries.jp: {v:003E}デュンケルスを吸収しているのか‥‥？{n}早く倒さねえと、手に負えなくなるぜ！
entries.en: {v:003E}Is it absorbing Dunkels...? We gotta take it down fast,{n}or it'll get out of hand!

entries.jp: {v:003F}もっとだ！{n}もっと力を！
entries.en: {v:003F}More! More power!

entries.jp: {v:0040}まだよ‥まだまだ強くなれるわ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0040}Not yet... I can grow stronger still...

entries.jp: {v:0041}みんな、急いで！{n}どんどん不利になっちゃうよ！
entries.en: {v:0041}Hurry, everyone! We're losing ground fast!

entries.jp: {v:0019}ニセ者が、本物にかなうはずないわ！
entries.en: {v:0019}A fake can never beat the real thing!

entries.jp: {v:001A}ニセ者、本物など関係ない。{n}オマエたちが滅べば、それでいいのだ。
entries.en: {v:001A}Fake or real, it makes no difference. As long as you all{n}perish, that is enough.

entries.jp: {v:001B}こんな存在を生み出してしまうとは、{n}我が一生の恥だな。
entries.en: {v:001B}To think I brought such a being into existence... It is{n}the shame of my life.

entries.jp: {v:001C}心配はいらない。{n}お前の一生などここで終わる。
entries.en: {v:001C}You need not worry. Your life ends here.

entries.jp: {v:001D}オレたちは負けねぇ！{n}絶対にな！
entries.en: {v:001D}We ain't losing! Not a chance!

entries.jp: {v:001E}デュンケルスで活性化したゲヴェル細胞‥‥。{p}{v:001F}こんなニセ者、許さない！
entries.en: {v:001E}Gevel cells activated by Dunkels...{p}{v:001F}I won't forgive fakes like these!

entries.jp: {v:0048}うぉおおっ！
entries.en: {v:0048}Raaaagh!

entries.jp: {v:0025}きゃあっ！{n}ま、また歪みが大きくなったの！？
entries.en: {v:0025}Kyaah! Th-the distortion grew bigger again?!
{v:0042}Ngh... Not yet... not yet...!

entries.jp: {v:0043}死んでなかったの！？
entries.en: {v:0043}You're not dead?!

entries.jp: {v:0044}忘れたか‥‥？{n}オレの中にもゲヴェル細胞があることを！
entries.en: {v:0044}Did you forget...? I have Gevel cells inside me too!

entries.jp: {v:0046}そんな‥‥この姿‥‥、{n}闇そのものじゃない‥‥！
entries.en: {v:0046}No... that form... it's darkness itself...!

entries.jp: {FFF7}{v:0047}‥‥絶対に‥‥この世界を‥‥、{n}滅ぼしてみせる！
entries.en: {FFF7}{v:0047}...I will... destroy... this world... no matter what!

entries.jp: {v:0024}きゃああっ！{n}歪みが大きくなった！？
entries.en: {v:0024}Kyaaah! The distortion's grown?!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0022}これ以上は、姿を維持できぬ‥‥。{n}ならば、歪みを‥‥！
entries.en: ...{v:0022}I can no longer maintain this form... Then,{n}the distortion...!

entries.jp: {v:0023}この肉体はもうダメね‥‥。{n}ならば最後に‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0023}This body is finished... Then, as a last resort...

entries.jp: ふ、復活した！？
entries.en: I-it came back to life?!

entries.jp: 俺の体内のゲヴェル細胞は、{n}デュンケルスによって何度も復活する！！
entries.en: The Gevel cells in my body will revive again and again{n}through Dunkels!!
